SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
D 3924
D 1/9/32

August 31, 32.

Acting Consul-General of Netherlands,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge, with thanks,
the receipt of your letter No.2390 of August 29, in
reference to Hungarian subject L. Tatz, and, in reply,
to inform you that the matter will receive attention.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) F. W. Gerrard
Commissioner of Police.

D.C.(Dir) [Signature]
a.c.(sp.Br.) — [Signature]
acc D.D.O. — [Signature]
Supt. C. I. — (notify B.H. Sec.)

W.K. (L) am 2/9/32 R.E. [Signature]

To see

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER SEP 1 1932 CRIME BRANCH）

The above name has
been noted in the
B.H. Sec. wanting
list for check.
125.95
[Signature]

pages.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 2390.    SHANGHAI,    29th August 1932.

Sir,

    I have the honour to inform you that I am in
receipt of a warning from Hongkong against the Hun-
garian subject L. Tatz, whose departure for Shanghai
from Canton, where his presence appears to be un-
desired by the authorities on account of his con-
nections with a gambling house in the French Con-
cession at Shameen, is anticipated.

                        I have the honour to be,
                                Sir,
                        Your obedient servant,

                        [Signature]
                        Acting Consul-General.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
        SHANGHAI.
pages.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话挂号：HOLLANDIA

第2390号。    上海，    1932年8月29日。

先生：

    谨此告知，本人收到来自香港的警告，针对匈牙利籍人士L. Tatz。此人预计将从广州启程前往上海，因其在沙面法租界一家赌场的关联，当地当局似乎不欢迎其逗留。

                        谨此致意，
                                先生，
                        您顺从的仆人，

                        [签名]
                        代理总领事。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处处长，
        上海。
